description: Disabled by DR-140 — the legacy prompt optimizer refuses every run
allowed-tools: []
argument-hint: "(disabled; every flag, including --dry-run, is refused)"
---

**Stop here. Do not run any other step, whatever flags were passed (including `--dry-run`).** Make no API call, and read or write no file.

Print exactly this message and end:

> `/council-optimize` is disabled by DR-140 (MoxyWolf Vault/Projects/Moxywolf Plugins/06-Engineering/DR-140-council-replay-cases-live-in-the-vault-by-project-2026-11-17.md). It stays disabled until the Council case store (CC-002) and a new optimizer item exist. Rating fields alone are not replayable cases, so this command no longer optimizes anything.
